items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: he'd been playing in Chicago with Keg Johnson and Budd Johnson and those fellows.

ctx.x: to drink. Nasty alcohol. Cheap. 25 cents for a little jar they had made like a little cow, and you'd get one of them. I drank some of that, spat it on a wall and messed the paint up. That's how bad this shit was. So all them trombone players was playin', Big Green was sittin' at the bar and listening. And then when Budd... And they were swingin' down there, man! Trombones burnin'. Higgenbotham and all of them.
So they asked Green to play. They said, "Man, play something, man." The bartender said, "Man, why don't you play something?" He had a funny eye...
